INVESTIGATION T-VALUES
A grid of any length and width 10 is numbered 1, 2, 3, … .
The grid has a letter T placed on it, as shown.
The T has a horizontal bar of length 3 and a vertical bar of length 2.
The T shown is shape 1 because the number in the top left square of the T is 1.
T-values are found using this method.
Method Calculation of T-value for shape 1
Square the number at the bottom of the T. 22 = 484
Multiply together the numbers at each end of the horizontal bar. 1 × 3 = 3
Take the second answer from the first answer to find the T-value. 484 – 3 = 481
The T-value for shape 1 is T = 481.
This investigation is about finding T-values.
